slug: 2024-12-04 World Bank approves $70M for Morocco's social protection delivery (RNP and Unified Social Registry)

facts.fact: The World Bank says the RSU serves as the single entry point for new social programmes in Morocco, with the project aiming to affect at least five programmes by end-2024 and eight by 2028.
The World Bank approved US$70 million for a second project extending the RNP and RSU to rural and remote areas through digital and remote applications.
